body.title: Protocol shapes for paging
body.summary: In protocol.ts add the optional `firstIndex` and `total` on session-restored, optional `rowIndex` on turn-event and user-row, the WebviewToHost `load-older` message and the HostToWebview `transcript-page` message; add 'load-older' to WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES and 'transcript-page' to HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES, with a protocol.test.ts case. Types only; no behaviour changes.
acceptanceChecks: The two unions carry the new messages and optional fields and the project typechecks
WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES includes 'load-older' and HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES includes 'transcript-page', with every prior kind still present

tests.name: WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES includes 'load-older' and HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES includes 'transcript-page', alongside every prior kind
